propositions: The test fixture equivalence assertion incorrectly requires a single raw build_ticket_position_commit_map call to succeed on first attempt, even though the production contract explicitly returns empty dict on Git/process/empty-output transients and relies on per-event fallback.

Under CI load, the batched git-log helper returns empty output (rc=128, rc=0, or BlockingIOError/EAGAIN) on first attempt while an immediate replay of identical arguments against the unchanged repository succeeds, indicating a documented transient read boundary.

The fixture-level test defect is independent of the prior loose-object ENOENT mechanism; deleting the 1005 blob (66842fd0...) left both broad and narrow git reads healthy, refuting that class as the cause of the batched-empty/narrow-success recurrence.

Bounded fixture-only recovery (_fixture_batched_map) must retry the exact batched resolver call up to five times, return on first complete map, and raise with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure, while leaving src/rebar authorship behavior and production fail-closed semantics unchanged.
